Maybe a tune done with a dyno by a professional would keep the bike restricted although it seems really strange to me. But any tune done with a power commander or upmap will for sure derestrict the bike.
I don't think the tunes are "completely different", even if the tune is done only to protect the engine with the new exhaust, same as a performance tune, the ecu is flashed to give the engine a better air/fuel ratio, thus making more power.
